name: @volt/contracts
description: Shared wire contracts (routes, request/response types, wire enums, and the plugin workflow model with its rules) consumed by the VOLT server, client and cluster daemon. Raw TypeScript source, no build step. There is no barrel: consumers import the concept file directly (`@volt/contracts/modules/x/routes` maps to src/modules/x/routes.ts through `exports`; the server and the daemon map it with a tsconfig path because they compile these files into their own dist). The daemon's runtime configuration types come from @voltstack/daemon-cluster-client, which owns the daemon protocol; they are imported type-only and add no runtime dependency. The ai-tools.ts files declare AI tool inputs as plain interfaces; the server turns each one into a JSON Schema with typia.llm.parameters<T>(), so the type is the only source of truth. Their `import type { tags } from 'typia'` is erased at compile time and adds no runtime dependency.
